recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-13457 unless a later work-group decision revises Event pattern status semantics more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-13457 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It requested removing Event.notDone, adding not-done as a status distinct from aborted/stopped activity, updating state-machine/invariant references to use status, and moving/renaming the not-done reason element; the Jira comment says the reason element was later subsumed into statusReason by FHIR-13907.
initial_application: SVN#12374, imported as git commit 5064224bd079b7f4ef4023d3ead9111b57bd8bff, removed Event.notDone/Event.notDoneReason, added Event.statusReason, and changed Event invariants to refer to status='not-done'. Follow-up commit c51d0794c04ae7d497f677da5309768774286d10 corrected EventStatus to include the not-done code.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists event as an active logical pattern and event-pattern-extensions as an active profile input. Current Event source uses on-hold/stopped rather than the older suspended/aborted names, while preserving the requested distinction between not-done before main activity and stopped after some main activity. FHIR-13907 and FHIR-7754 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source/event files define Event.status with not-done, Event.statusReason for exception states including not-done, an Event invariant based on status='not-done', and EventStatus terminology that distinguishes not-done from stopped. No active Event.notDone/Event.notDoneReason surface remains.
